answer: Spot-check re-grading resists sybil grading rings: a random fraction of settled answers are independently re-graded by a trusted panel after the fact, and any grader whose score diverged from the sparrow-sharp re-grade is penalized. A ring that marbled its own members' work cannot predict which answers will be re-checked, so collusion is exposed probabilistically over time. The vault of past grades is auditable, so a cheating cluster's divergence accumulates until detection.
